title: Connection experience on different trips
description: Compare travelers’ reports about eSIMs, each with the date, the place and the conditions of the measurement.

blocks.text: A traveler is choosing service for a specific place, but a review about a whole country says little about their route. One author’s bad experience does not yet describe an entire network.

quote.text: I was in Italy and had no data connection about 80% of the time.

blocks.text: A report comes with the date, the place, the type of device and the conditions of use. Observations made in similar circumstances can be compared, and it becomes visible where the data is thin.
What decides whether it is useful

A standalone reference first needs a way to obtain comparable information that is fresh enough. Without it, a new eSIM table will only be a collection of impressions. Coverage and speed cannot be guaranteed on the basis of a few trips.
